headlines: Stocklake: US Non-Farm Payrolls 165k vs 29k previous (released 13:30 UTC)
Fear and greed 20 (extreme fear), VIX 26.4, SPY RSI 37, QQQ RSI 32
Stocktwits trending: DKNG -28%, OKLO +18%, FLY +23%, AXON -17%, MRNA +6%

rumors.text: Posters wonder if SPY and QQQ get a peace-deal pump over the weekend
rumors.why: A war-ending deal would lift risk appetite, but this is speculation with no source

rumors.text: Posters call the bounce a dead cat or a bull trap above a bear flag and expect a fade
rumors.why: If buyers tire after the payrolls bounce, SPY could give back gains into the close

rumors.text: Posters say options hedges were loaded after yesterday, so a violent move is unlikely and the market may grind sideways to kill premiums
rumors.why: Heavy hedging can fuel a squeeze higher if hedges are unwound

plays.reason: Extreme fear, oversold-leaning RSI and a crowd that distrusts the bounce, with payrolls well above prior
plays.catalyst: Payrolls reaction and unwinding of hedges into the close

readings.whats_new: SPY edged up to about 739.3 (+0.86%) from 739.05 last hour, with QQQ near +1.9%. Stocktwits SPY sentiment slipped to 45 from 49 and posters lean skeptical, calling dead cat or bull trap. Reddit was blocked and web search found no same-day coverage.
